.climb { position: relative; margin: 1.2rem 0 1rem; }

/* Everything you can hover */
.climb .spot { cursor: pointer; outline: none; }

.climb .peak .spot-body { transform-origin: bottom center; }
.climb .spot:hover .spot-body, .climb .spot:focus .spot-body, .climb .spot.on .spot-body { transform: scale(1.12); filter: brightness(1.08); }
.climb .peak:hover .spot-body, .climb .peak:focus .spot-body, .climb .peak.on .spot-body { transform: scale(1.03); }

/* The bubble */
.climb-bubble { position: absolute; z-index: 10; width: max-content; max-width: 260px;

<!-- What each bubble says -->
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-syllabus"><b>Base camp: the syllabus</b>Due dates, grading and course policies.<span class="hint">Click to open</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-m1"><b>Milestone 1 · release 0.0.1</b>Set up your team's GitHub repo, a uv or renv environment, and your analysis in one Quarto document.<br>The tallest climb: a complete, simple data anlysis with a professional report.<span class="hint">Click to open</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-m2"><b>Milestone 2 · release 1.0.0</b>Move your environment into a Docker container, and publish your report on GitHub Pages. <span class="hint">Click to open</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-m3"><b>Milestone 3 · release 2.0.0</b>Split your analysis into 4 or more scripts, and add data validation checks.<br>A gentle hill: it's exam week in your other courses.<span class="hint">Page opens in week 3</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-m4"><b>Milestone 4 · release 3.0.0</b>One command (<code>make all</code>) runs everything. Add functions with tests, polish the report, and fix feedback to win back points.<span class="hint">Page opens in week 4</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-ia1"><b>Individual Assignment 1</b>Version control practice with Git and GitHub.<span class="hint">Click to open</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-contract"><b>Teamwork contract</b>How your team will work together. <span class="hint">Click to open</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-ia2"><b>Individual Assignment 2</b>Build your own small Docker image: the warm-up for Milestone 2.<span class="hint">Click to open</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-ia3"><b>Individual Assignment 3</b>Quarto report practice. You'll use it to polish your report in Milestone 4.<span class="hint">Page opens in week 3</span></div>
<div class="tip-src" id="tip-ia4"><b>Individual Assignment 4</b>Write a Makefile: the warm-up for Milestone 4.<span class="hint">Page opens in week 4</span></div>

<script>
(() => {
  const wrap = document.querySelector(".climb");
  const bubble = wrap.querySelector(".climb-bubble");
  const svg = wrap.querySelector("svg");
  let current = null, lastPointer = "mouse";

  // Stop the otter for anyone who asked their system for reduced motion
  if (window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches && svg.pauseAnimations) svg.pauseAnimations();

  // Mountains are big, so their bubble follows the pointer; small stops anchor to themselves
  function show(el, e) {
    const src = document.getElementById("tip-" + el.dataset.tip);
    if (!src) return;
    if (current !== el) {
      if (current) current.classList.remove("on");
      current = el; el.classList.add("on");
      bubble.innerHTML = src.innerHTML;
    }
    const usePointer = el.classList.contains("peak") && e && e.clientX !== undefined;
    const r = usePointer
      ? { left: e.clientX, width: 0, top: e.clientY - 8, bottom: e.clientY + 8 }
      : el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    const half = Math.min(bubble.offsetWidth, w.width) / 2;
    const x = Math.max(half, Math.min(w.width - half, r.left + r.width / 2 - w.left));
    const below = r.top - w.top < bubble.offsetHeight + 16;
    bubble.classList.toggle("below", below);
    bubble.style.left = x + "px";
    bubble.style.top = (below ? r.bottom - w.top : r.top - w.top) + "px";
    bubble.classList.add("show");
  }
  function hide() {
    bubble.classList.remove("show");
    if (current) current.classList.remove("on");
    current = null;
  }

  wrap.querySelectorAll(".spot").forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { lastPointer = e.pointerType; });
    el.addEventListener("mouseenter", e => { if (lastPointer === "mouse") show(el, e); });
    el.addEventListener("mousemove", e => { if (lastPointer === "mouse" && el.classList.contains("peak")) show(el, e); });
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { if (lastPointer === "mouse") hide(); });
    el.addEventListener("focus", () => show(el));
    el.addEventListener("blur", hide);
    // On a phone, the first tap shows the bubble; a second tap opens the link
    el.addEventListener("click", e => {
      if (lastPointer !== "mouse" && current !== el) { e.preventDefault(); show(el, e); }
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => { if (!e.target.closest(".climb .spot")) hide(); });
  wrap.querySelector(".climb-scroll").addEventListener("scroll", hide);
})();
</script>
